newFinding: Beyond the previously inspected weight-two adic endpoints, published proof bodies construct a rank-two residual representation at every weight k >= 3 from a nonzero genuine Gamma0 cusp eigenform, an integral Hecke eigencharacter, and a ring homomorphism from the integral closure of Z in C to the characteristic-p coefficient field. The theorem derives finite-level factorization, good-prime Frobenius traces, determinant ell^(k-1), and inertia triviality away from Np.
proofRoute: An actual modular Hecke eigenform gives a nonzero binary-coefficient H1 eigensystem after reduction.
Commuting finite-dimensional Hecke actions extend the eigensystem to all good primes.
Finite-characteristic coefficient and level changes reduce it, after cyclotomic twist, to trivial-coefficient H1 at a level M dividing N*p^2.
Weight-two geometric Galois association or an Eisenstein character-pair construction supplies the residual representation.
The explicit cyclotomic twist restores traces and determinant and preserves unramifiedness away from Np.
